scope: Pure controller with virtual clock and fake renderer/server. No visual, database, or public deployment acceptance.

results.name: requirements exclude every event with an unowned required actor
ownership loss releases task and blocks late reserve response
work reserve precedes physical movement, activation follows arrival and real clip
missing animation never activates or claims a work reward
station slot is exclusive; every suitable character can reserve when released
unreachable routes never reserve server work or teleport
reserved offline job must physically arrive again before activate
optional chain members absent are skipped without spawning or error
multi-participant event waits for all real routes and releases all leases
losing a chain participant cancels the event and frees the other participants
arrival is acknowledged once only after walking and greeting
rare events are not scheduled every twenty seconds
memory is bounded, decays, and relationship dimensions remain separate
clock jumps never create negative needs or claim unactivated work
rebind preserves needs and jobs instead of reinitializing the controller
read-only visitor controller never submits life commands
dispose prevents asynchronous callbacks from restoring life state
weighted decisions expose varied life states while unavailable furniture is not invented
older server revisions cannot restore removed ownership or stale jobs
duplicate IPC forwarding and later heartbeat do not replay an offline receipt
station stages require available real clips and play distinct actions
event action gate requires decoded art, not a semantic action name
repeated taps use authored escalation without mutating economy
furniture removed during editor suspension cancels its reservation safely
real authored data integrates without admitting unowned cast or nonexistent furniture
